threat_event: An attack on the Florida facility business network takes down vault PACS and intrusion detection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vault security systems share the facility business network
existing_controls: Alarm company monitoring; guards as compensatory measure
treatment_plan: Security network with its own switches, firewall, and UPS (done at the other facility in 2025)

threat_event: Vault security communications fail with no alternate path
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No alternate data path not subject to the same failure modes
existing_controls: Guard post; alarm company call tree
treatment_plan: Cellular alternate path for the intrusion detection communicator and PACS server

threat_event: Vendor remote access to processing PLCs at the Florida facility is abused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote access with a shared account and no MFA
treatment_plan: Per-session access with named accounts, MFA, and recording

threat_event: Part 37 security plan information is disclosed
Ransomware halts waste tracking and manifests
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Division staff share group identity and endpoints
existing_controls: Vendor backups; nightly export to group vault

threat_event: Tracking of a category 2 shipment is lost
treatment_plan: Carrier tracking portal as second source

threat_event: OT devices with default passwords at the second facility are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default passwords on 4 HMIs found in 2025; 2 still not changed
treatment_plan: Change remaining passwords; add OT default credential checks

threat_event: Radwaste crew laptops connect to group station networks and carry malware
